Hi, I'm Sarah

I'm a qualified textiles teacher with a degree in Textiles from Falmouth University and years of experience working with fabrics, sewing and alterations. I also run my own business, The Campervan Tailor, creating bespoke cushions and upholstery for campervans.

​

I'm a busy mum of two, with a little one at home and a daughter at NJA. I love putting my sewing skills to good use, whether that's giving a favourite outfit a new lease of life, adjusting curtains or bigger reupholstery projects.

How it works

Get in touch

Tell me what you'd like altering using the contact form below. I'll get back to you to discuss what's needed and give you an idea of the cost.

Drop off & measure up

Drop your items off at my home in Newquay, or arrange a convenient handover during the NJA school run. We'll discuss any measurements before I get to work.

Collect & enjoy

I'll get to work making your alterations and let you know as soon as everything is ready to collect. Simple as that!
